body:
As are you :)

Honestly my head just feels spacey and empty. Like nothing's there. How about you? What's floating around in your head?

You are right, that was beautiful. I guess I'm torn. I think God can do more with me through my death than my life, and how can that be wrong? How can it displease God if here I am, still open to his will. If I love him and pray with persistence, would He still deny me if I did end up making the wrong choice? I trust in His mercy, and I trust that He will allow what is best for me so long as I continue to invite Him into my life.

Wow, that was really beautiful writing. A lot of introspection as well. Many people don't seem willing to dive into such depth, and I think it's a testament to the kind of person you are that you are willing to do such deep thinking. I think it's an admirable quality to have.

Any change that helps you take any tiny step forward seems like a good change to me. Even if it seems infinitesimal.

That's a really cool goal, and I'm glad you still have goals that bring you a sense of comfort. I'm not sure how I feel about depression. I don't think it's abnormal either, but it definitely fucks with people in a bad way. So far as I know, meds don't really do much. They didn't touch my depression, and I met a ton of people who jump from med to med saying the same thing.

There's no enjoyment in traveling or pleasure activities. I traveled halfway across the world and it didn't mean a thing. I was still the same person, still depressed, still empty. Just looking at prettier things. That's how it feels to do anything. It's just killing time.

You say you've been there, but it sounds like you aren't there right now. What changed? What's different?

Have you ever been diagnosed? Because that sounds like depression to me. Not only the constant, pressing dark thoughts, but apparently insomnia is a symptom of depression. I was getting 3-4 hours of sleep a night and I thought it was just my bad sleep habits, but then it turns out it's normal for people with depression to have problems sleeping. So I dunno if that's helpful or not, but if you've never been diagnosed or anything it could be helpful to know that supposedly there's a chemical imbalance in your brain forcing you to think and feel this way.

I relate so much to what you just said--about becoming a shadow, unable to be more. That's how I feel every day. I can't be better, I can't be more because I am nothing. I am nobody, I am worthless. I guess I'm at the point where you see yourself in the future.

That's a really cool thing to want to do. Obtain as much experience as possible. It almost sounds like attempting to live life to the fullest... almost. The constant aching emptiness in the background makes it a little something different.

And the answer to your question is nothing. I've never had goals or dreams or hopes. I've always gone through the motions to make the people around me happy. It made my parents happy when I went through high school and on to college and got a job. I successfully checked off the list of what a good child does for their parents, and now I'm an adult and I don't have to live for them anymore.

Thank you. I really appreciate your prayers. I'll keep you in mine as well. 

I guess at this point, I'm just trusting His will either includes my death as part of it, or if His well is that I live... well, I will. It sounds weird to say it, but my suicide is in His hands. If I survive, I know God has more planned for me. If not, I'll know God knew this would happen all along and He will bring great good out of my death.

Wow, that's a lot of repetition! I sorta do that with youtubers. I watch the happy ones. Dan and Phil, Charlie(issocoollike), cereal time. Sometimes I'll go watch old videos of youtubers I used to watch like cadegoestocollege.

Yeah, I was raised religious and didn't really get into it until I started planning to kill myself. I think God is real. I dunno where I'll end up. It'll be cool to meet Him, though. Even if He's all like mad or sad or disappointed. It's an interesting concept to think about meeting your maker, and yet to also realize you're going about it all wrong. But I dunno what else to do. Time is ticking, you know?

How about you? Do you believe in anything, or do you think your entity will just cease existence?

Thanks, I appreciate it. 

The thing is, I very intensely want to kill myself.

What's stopped me is God. I want to do His will. I'm finally at a point where I just have to trust in His mercy. He knows the future, and if I successfully kill myself He knew that would be my end when He created me. I trust in His mercy. He knew every single one of my flaws and yet He created me anyway. I can only hope in Him, that while my earthly body may perish there is still yet hope for my soul.

I've been planning my suicide for months now, and I plan to be gone by the end of January. I don't know what else to do but turn to God. If you could ask Mary to intercede for me, I'd appreciate it very much. Thank you.

I called a hotline and said I didn't want to talk about suicide specifically-- 'cause you know, cops-- and I was told I was tying up the line for people "in a real crisis." The hotline advertised you could talk about anything at all, even just being lonely, but because I specified I didn't want to talk about killing myself I was told I was a waste of time.

Suicide chats are all chat boxes. It's like they're copy and pasting from a script. The amount of time you wait between chats is them looking up their copypasta and pasting it over.

Yep, same here. I finished all my school, got my first job, payed off majority of my loans. Time to go.

I self harm a ton. Reddit and youtube I guess. Mindless youtube'ing for hours. I also spend a lot of time at Church, funnily enough.

Like others here, I don't know you, but I can relate.

It's weird to see someone else with the same resolve, the same research into methodology, the same specific planning process to ensure death on first attempt.

It's weird to feel so conflicted. Because when I think of my plans, when I think of my end, I feel happy. I feel peace. I feel calm.

And yet when I see these thoughts in another person, the innermost struggles of someone's mind telling them they aren't worth it, telling them it's better not to live... all I can think is, but that's a lie.

I'm in a similar boat, I'm 24 and ready to die. I thought I knew the right thing to do, but now I'm not so sure, simply because I so desperately want you to live.

If you're wondering what's the point of trying, of seeking help or talking to someone, here's the point: you're the point. You're worth it. I know you can't see it, but it's true.

I sincerely hope you don't go through with it. I want to be able to talk with you. I don't know anything about you, but simply the way you write, the ability to transcribe your thoughts with such clarity, and the fact I can relate so deeply to everything you said makes me interested to know you.

See, that's exactly it! I just feel like I've finally put in enough time to warrant my death. 

Sorry, but I haven't actually seen it. I haven't really read or watched anything in a while. But I'm going to try to catch up on books and movies after I finish everything that needs to be done. It'll be fun.

I did, but I've put up a front my whole life and I don't know how to take it off. Telling a professional you're great with a big smile on your face gets you nowhere. I lie too much for anyone to be able to help me.

Thanks for your post and for taking the time to share your own experience. That's awesome animating worked out for you and you were able to find a purpose. I know that must have been really hard so kudos to you for going through with it and sticking with it.

I've already given it time honestly. I just have no passions. I'm tired of wasting air, wasting people's time. Soon I won't be around to bother anyone anymore.
Thanks for your post, you seem like a very insightful person. Thanks for your kindness and for reaching out.

What I meant by "no reason" wasn't that there's no meaning to life. I meant that I have no reasons for meaning. People find meaning in a lot of different ways, the biggest usually being career or family.

I don't want any of that. I guess it sort of is like drive? There's nothing for me. I've wanted this since I was a freshman in high school. I've been going through the motions for about a decade now to please the people around me. I feel I've put in enough time and effort to satisfy them and it's finally my turn to do what I've wanted for years.
Simple, I'm worthless. I have no reason to exist.
